name: Nilay Şanlı
bio: Nilay Şanlı was born in Istanbul in 1980. After graduating from Anadolu University in Eskişehir with a degree in Tourism and Hotel Management, she continued her professional training in London. After becoming a mother, she discovered the magical world of children’s books and began writing for children. Along the way, she recognized children’s natural talent for philosophy and started crafting her books as P4C (Philosophy for Children) prompts. She currently lives in Antalya with her family and their dog. She draws her inspiration from the shining eyes of children and the streets of the land of dreams.
